edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the `from` address of transfers via _transfer(_msgSender(), ...).
tx.origin is used as the key of the _holderLastTransferTimestamp mapping, controlling per-origin transfer rate.
tx.origin gates the one-purchase-per-block check inside _transfer.
enableTrading sets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp, making the burn schedule time dependent.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger the auto LP burn.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router addLiquidityETH deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens records lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens enforces its cooldown with block.timestamp.
`from` parameter is consumed by _transfer for balance and limit checks.
`to` parameter is consumed by _transfer for wallet-limit and fee-side checks.
`amount` parameter is consumed by _transfer for limits, fees and the final transfer.
newAmount is validated against totalSupply and stored as swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is scaled by 1e18 and stored as maxTransactionAmount.
percent feeds amountToBurn = liquidityPairBalance.mul(percent).div(10000).
_frequencyInSeconds is validated and stored as lpBurnFrequency.
_percent is validated and stored as percentForLPBurn.
_Enabled is stored as lpBurnEnabled.
contractTokenBalance drives the swapBack() trigger condition and amount computation.
takeFee decides whether fee deduction branches execute.
amount.mul(sellTotalFees).div(100) and amount.mul(buyTotalFees).div(100) compute fees.
computed fees are subtracted from amount and transferred to the contract.
liquidityTokens derives from contractBalance, tokensForLiquidity and totalTokensToSwap.
totalTokensToSwap is the divisor used to compute liquidityTokens.
amountToSwapForETH = contractBalance.sub(liquidityTokens).
the swapping flag guards re-entrant swap/fee logic in _transfer.
maxTransactionAmount bounds buy and sell amounts in _transfer.
swapTokensAtAmount is compared against the contract token balance in _transfer.
maxWallet bounds recipient balances in _transfer.
tradingActive gates non-excluded transfers in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swapBack() call in _transfer.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written by the tx.origin transfer-delay check.
transferDelayEnabled gates the per-block transfer delay logic.
sellTotalFees is used as the fee numerator/divisor on sells.
buyTotalFees is used as the fee numerator/divisor on buys.
tokensForMarketing is summed and split into ETH within swapBack().
tokensForLiquidity is summed and halved within swapBack().
tokensForDev is summed and split into ETH within swapBack().
uniswapV2Router is the target of approve and swap in swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is the target of approve and addLiquidityETH.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
uniswapV2Pair is the target of the sync() external call.
marketingWallet is the recipient of the final low-level value call in swapBack().
devWallet is the recipient of the low-level value call in swapBack().
_transfer calls swapBack() when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens() when the LP burn schedule elapses.
swapBack() calls swapTokensForEth() to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack() calls addLiquidity() to pair the liquidity share.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call.
swapBack() executes a low-level value call to devWallet before completing distribution.
swapBack() executes a low-level value call to marketingWallet with the remaining balance.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
low-level call to devWallet can re-enter the token _transfer path while swapBack() is running.
low-level call to marketingWallet can re-enter the token _transfer path while swapBack() is running.
router swap moves tokens and can trigger _transfer on this contract during swapBack().
router addLiquidityETH pulls tokens, potentially re-entering _transfer during swapBack().

normalization_plan.reason: `from` is only used as the source address inside _transfer and carries no standalone semantics.
`to` is only used as the destination address inside _transfer.
`amount` is only consumed by _transfer for limits, fees and the final transfer.
newAmount only exists to validate and write swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum only exists to validate and write maxTransactionAmount.
percent only feeds the manual LP burn arithmetic.
_frequencyInSeconds is only validated and stored as lpBurnFrequency.
_percent is only validated and stored as percentForLPBurn.
contractTokenBalance is a transient read of the contract balance used only in _transfer.
takeFee is a branch flag local to _transfer.
fees is a transient arithmetic result used only within _transfer.
contractBalance is a transient capped balance local to swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is a transient sum of fee buckets local to swapBack.
liquidityTokens is a transient liquidity share computed in swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is a transient swap quantity computed in swapBack.
